{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    paths-ignore:
      - '**.md'
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - '**.md'
  workflow_dispatch:

name: CI

env:
  RUST_TOOLCHAIN: stable
  TOOLCHAIN_PROFILE: minimal

jobs:
  fmt:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: stable / fmt
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Install stable
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
      - name: cargo fmt
        run: cargo fmt --check
  clippy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: stable / clippy
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Install stable
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: clippy
      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
      - name: cargo clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --workspace -- -D warnings
  doc:
    # run docs generation on nightly rather than stable. This enables features like
    # https://doc.rust-lang.org/beta/unstable-book/language-features/doc-cfg.html which allows an
    # API be documented as only available in some specific platforms.
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: nightly / doc
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Install nightly
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
      - name: Install cargo-docs-rs
        uses: dtolnay/install@cargo-docs-rs
      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
      - name: cargo docs-rs
        run: cargo docs-rs -p vaultrs
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: stable / test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Install stable
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
      - name: cargo test
        run: cargo test --locked --all-targets --all-features --workspace -- --include-ignored
      # https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/issues/6669
      - name: cargo test --doc
        run: cargo test --locked --all-features --workspace --doc

  publish:
    name: Publish to crates.io
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    needs: [fmt, clippy, test]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
            profile: ${{ env.TOOLCHAIN_PROFILE }}
            toolchain: ${{ env.RUST_TOOLCHAIN }}
            override: true
      - uses: katyo/publish-crates@v1
        with:
            registry-token: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}",
  "rationale": "APPLY P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads). This Rust CI runs four cargo jobs (fmt, clippy, doc, test) that fetch/build dependencies on every run with no dependency cache. Evidence: pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE reports a reported_benefit (modest aggregate VM-time reduction) and the measured fork experiment batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200 shows adding actions/cache@v4 cut elapsed time about 20.4% while keeping all checks passing. Preconditions are met: Cargo.lock exists in the repository for a stable cache key, repeated cargo dependency fetching occurs, and no equivalent cache already exists. Contraindications do not apply: cargo registry content is immutable/content-addressed, and no cache is present. The change adds actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cargo/registry and ~/.cargo/git keyed on runner.os and the Cargo.lock hash before each cargo command, following the pattern's method of caching dependency download state rather than build outputs. All existing checks are preserved unchanged and the publish job is untouched, so no permissions are weakened, no secrets/publishing/deployment behavior is added, and no new external network access is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
